Now, I've noticed, that many youth are writing fiction. Some stories I've noticed contain haram love, killing and fabricating creatures and worlds. I?ve been writing but this question has been bugging me for a very long time. So I wanted to go into detail a bit about fiction writing Are these permissible? 1. Is fabricating worlds, lands (i.e such as the lands of Middle Earth by Tolkien or Narnia by Lewis.) and creatures permissible? 2. Having bloodshed (including against non-existent creatures). 3. In detail describing characters of the opposite gender (a male writer describing the complexion and characteristics of a female character, or a female writer describing a male character). 4. Unlawful situations taking place (an obvious one is kissing, but how about a character killing in rage?) does it make the story unlawful to write? 5. Finally, what if the story ends up with a message, or situations the character(s) go through which teaches or shows a person right from wrong (Including the above four) Considering these factors, is writing still permissible? 3979 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 4858 Country: Pakistan Title: My daughter is 20 years old she is not ready to get married she is studing in a unversity and wears western clothes all the time i am very worried about her please pray for her quick haddiat i have being praying and reading loads of wazfas but she is getting from bad to worse. Question: assalaamoalekum respected sir my daughter is 20 years old she is not ready to get married she is studing in a unversity and wears western clothes all the time i am very worried about her please pray for her quick haddiat i have being praying and reading loads of wazfas but she is getting from bad to worse. jazakumullah Answer ID: 4858 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 932/897=D-1429 The boys and girls should be nurtured from their childhood as per the Shariah so that their mindset and thoughts become religious and they act upon Islamic rulings and moral values amid the western evils which destroys Eiman and spreads vice. However, you should sympathetically and politely try to persuade her and take her with you to women religious conventions and keep reciting this below dua: اللهم اصلح لى فى ذريتي ( ال آ ية) Also, sometimes you should offer two rakah salah with fresh ablution and p ray to Allah for guidance, peace and belief weeping thoroughly before Allah Almighty. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
